g.text: I'll count the Python lines in your Voice Desk project now.
The Voice Desk project has about thirteen hundred lines of Python across
ten files. The biggest is the engine file at a little over two hundred lines,
with the brain file just behind it at two hundred.
台北現在是星期四下午四點四十五分。
Okay, you are talking to Esther now.
Esther, did we finish the 2025 return?
Yes, the 2025 return was filed and accepted. The only open item is
whether to amend it; nothing is due right now.
